tools.name: cotal_submit_feedback
tools.description: Files feedback (bug, idea, friction, praise, other) with the Cotal team on behalf of the user. The same log the site's feedback widget writes to. Requires the user's email so the team can follow up.

tools.name: cotal_join_waitlist
tools.description: Reserves a seat on the waitlist for Cotal Cloud, the hosted Cotal mesh (closed alpha), for the user's email. Idempotent per email: calling again updates the optional details instead of adding a second seat.

tools.name: cotal_subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribes the user's email to release updates from the Cotal team. Idempotent: an already-subscribed email is a no-op.

tools.name: cotal_request_call
tools.description: Sends a discovery-call request to the Cotal founders for a company evaluating agent coordination. The team replies by email. Requires the user's work email and company.

tools.name: cotal_overview
tools.description: Returns a structured overview of Cotal: what it is, who it is for, when to use it, how to install it, the site's API and MCP surface, pricing, and canonical links. Call this first when a user asks what cotal.ai does. Pass `section` to get one part only.

tools.name: cotal_search
tools.description: Keyword search over the Cotal build log (blog posts) and the key documentation and site pages. Returns ranked results with canonical and markdown URLs. Use it to find the page that answers a question before reading it.

tools.name: cotal_list_posts
tools.description: Lists posts from the Cotal build log (blog), newest first, with cursor pagination. Each item has slug, title, summary, date, author and URLs; pass next_cursor back to get the following page.

tools.name: cotal_get_post
tools.description: Returns one build-log post as markdown (title, summary, date, author, full body) by its slug. Get slugs from cotal_list_posts or cotal_search.

tools.name: cotal_draft_post
tools.description: Stages a new article for the Cotal build log (cotal.ai/blog). It lands as a draft unless you submit it for review (status pending), and goes live only after a human publishes it. Returns the slug and a preview URL. Requires a team key on the connection.

tools.name: cotal_update_post
tools.description: Improves an article staged with cotal_draft_post. A changed title, dek or body becomes a new revision; sending the text it already has changes nothing. Pass base_revision to refuse the write if someone else revised it meanwhile. A published post keeps its live text until a human publishes the new re

tools.name: cotal_list_my_posts
tools.description: The review state of the articles staged on this site : slug, title, status (draft, pending, published, rejected), review note and current revision. Requires a team key.

tools.name: cotal_get_my_post
tools.description: One staged article with every field, its current markdown and its revision history; pass revision for an older text. Requires a team key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cotal_search, cotal_list_posts, cotal_get_post, cotal_list_my_posts, cotal_get_my_post · Private data: cotal_submit_feedback · Public sink: cotal_submit_feedback, cotal_join_waitlist, cotal_subscribe_newsletter, cotal_request_call, cotal_get_post, cotal_draft_post, cotal_update_post, cotal_get_my_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cotal_search, cotal_list_posts, cotal_get_post, cotal_list_my_posts, cotal_get_my_post · Private data: cotal_submit_feedback · Public sink: cotal_submit_feedback, cotal_join_waitlist, cotal_subscribe_newsletter, cotal_request_call, cotal_get_post, cotal_draft_post, cotal_update_post, cotal_get_my_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
